name: Husbands And Wives
overview: Scripture reveals the sacred and complementary roles of husbands and wives within marriage, emphasizing the husband's loving leadership as Christ's headship over the church and the wife's respectful submission to her husband as to the Lord. A wife is portrayed as a precious and virtuous gift, highly valued by God, while husbands are called to love their wives sacrificially and intimately, as they love their own bodies. This divine pattern underscores the spiritual unity and mutual care that characterize the marital relationship.
